# Phase 3: Media & Audio Overhauls
- Date: 2026-06-10 - Execution: - Discovered `.cpp` files in `patches/01_Media_Audio_Video` were wiped by Vault-First. - Reconstructed patches using 0-noise rulebook data and recent mathematical specification: - `dom/media/AudioStream.cpp`: Implemented 2.0x volume expansion. Applied a synomial/polynomial soft-knee compression curve using `tanh` mapping (`y = T + (1-T) * tanh((x-T)/(1-T))`) at a 0.85f threshold to protect against clipping within `DataCallback`. - `dom/media/CubebUtils.cpp`: Unconditionally hard-locked `sPreferredSampleRate` to `48000` in `InitPreferredSampleRate()`. - `dom/media/platforms/PDMFactory.cpp`: Fixed `SupportsMimeType` check to only enforce `!MP4Decoder::IsH264(aMimeType)` rejection when `StringBeginsWith(aMimeType, "video/"_ns)`, preventing accidental audio blockades. - Validation: `./mach build` initiated.
